title: Recognize declared-only history in a selected linked worktree without a turn trace
outcome: Direct and delayed recognition locate declarations in the exact selected linked worktree on the history-only path, while preserving separation of execution location and proof.
acceptance: A declared-only test in selected linked worktree B appears in history for both direct and delayed command frames when session workdir A has no matching declaration.
Refused or off-root commands retain only the history fields they are authorized to use and cannot earn proof or credit.
